slides.title: Start the connector
slides.html: Start the connector and open the address it prints (see Install the connector). The first time it asks you to add your Deploy App.

slides.title: Not the Deploy App admin?
slides.html: Not the Deploy App admin? Ask the admin to open enrolment, press Copy settings and send you the line by a way you both trust.

slides.title: Paste the line
slides.html: Paste the line under Paste its settings line: and press Continue. Then skip to Add your Deploy App.

slides.title: Open the MDM page
slides.html: Are you the admin? On the same computer and in the same browser, sign in to Deploy App. Open User Management, then MDM.

slides.title: Open enrolment
slides.html: Press Open for 2 hours. Every opening makes a new challenge, which your MDM needs.

slides.title: Hand it to the connector
slides.html: Press Open in the MDM connector. It opens the connector in a new tab, with this opening's settings.

slides.title: Add your Deploy App
slides.html: Check that the name is your Deploy App's, then press Add unit.example.fi. Any web page can open the connector, so add only the one you expect.

slides.title: Get a token from Fleet
slides.html: The connector needs an API token from Fleet. Ask whoever runs your Fleet for the API token of an API-only user who is a global admin: one from My account ends after some days.

slides.title: Fleet's address
slides.html: Type the address you open Fleet at, and press Next.

slides.title: The token
slides.html: Paste the token and press Next. With Remember on this computer ticked, the keychain keeps it for the next start.

slides.title: The team
slides.html: Leave Team as Deploy App unless you want another name: the team is made if it is not there. Press Connect.

slides.title: It sets Fleet up
slides.html: The connector sets your team up in Fleet: this can take a minute or two. Each step is ticked when it is done.

slides.title: Connected
slides.html: Your team in Fleet now has the certificate, the policy, the apps and the Deploy App icon. Press Show the phones.

slides.title: Ready for phones
slides.html: The page lists the team's phones: none yet. Leave it open and enrol the phones.

slides.title: Without the connector
slides.html: No connector? Technical staff can set most of this up in Fleet by hand: see Connect your MDM without the connector.
